text: The purpose of this report is to seek Council's approval of a strategy pertaining to the acquisition of properties from public agencies wherein an environmental indemnity is required to be given by the City. The Director of Real Estate Services, pursuant to Item GM24.7, adopted by Council of January 31 and February 1, 2018 (the "Elmcrest Report"), was directed to develop such strategy.

City Council on May 22, 23 and 24, 2018, adopted the following: 1. City Council amend the existing delegated approvals and signing authorities adopted by City Council on October 2, 3 and 4, 2017, in Item EX27.12, so as to add the General Condition identified in Appendix A to the report (April 20, 2018) from the Director, Real Estate Services, in order to authorize the grant of unqualified environmental indemnities in certain limited circumstances involving the purchase of low risk properties from a public agency. 2. City Council direct that in cases where the environmental risk exceeds the Low Risk level identified in Appendix A, to the report (April 20, 2018) from the Director, Real Estate Services and the City remains interested in acquiring the property for its intended purpose, the Director, Real Estate Services negotiate favourable terms on behalf of the City to recover the value…
